technical_facts.value: 100 items: 40 driving MP4, 20 Protected MP4, 28 parking MP4 and 12 JPG. Each camera has 10 driving, five protected, seven parking videos and three photos. Owner reports manual emergency events; HDR and firmware not recorded.
